modifiers: eye badge in bottom right corner
depiction.composition: prohibition circle with bottom-right cutout for an eye icon

readings.meaning: view blocked users or ignored items

ambiguity: Easy to confuse with a slashed-eye icon (hide/invisible), or hard to tell whether the eye is being prohibited (no viewing) or viewing what is prohibited (inspect blocklist).

modifier_semantics.modifier: eye badge in bottom right corner

task_intents: restrict public access to private content
enable privacy mode or ad blocker

Turn off lock-screen message previews on WhatsApp and Signal

Redact bank account numbers and SSNs from the tax PDFs before uploading to the portal
Lock down Facebook photo albums from 2012 so only close friends can see them
Configure Confluence permissions so external vendors cannot view the internal roadmap pages

reasoning: Combines a prohibition sign with an eye badge, clearly signaling privacy, restricted viewing, hidden content, or content filtering/blocking. While useful for digital privacy, parental control, and redaction tasks, it closely competes with the standard slashed-eye 'hide' icon.
